{{Top|leg}}
This '''resistance group''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] during the years of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s rule. They were based in hidden rooms beneath [[Kal'Shebbol starport]], but were gradually wiped out in a series of skirmishes with the Moff's security forces. The last survivor was [[Genna Seedar]], who acted as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] for the group.
